svg.title: KEDA event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture for KEDA: external event sources produce activity signals; KEDA operator watches ScaledObject/ScaledJob CRDs, polls event sources via scalers, exposes metrics through the metrics adapter, and triggers Kubernetes HPA or Job scaling. Workload scaling is driven by asynchronous event-source activity rather than direct user requests.

svg.text: scaler polls event source for metric value

g.text: One per event source type · collect metric

g.text: Expose scaler metric values to Kubernetes HPA via External Metrics API

g.text: Deployment replicas · StatefulSet replicas · Job runners — process event backlog

svg.text: Scaling triggered by asynchronous event-source activity — not direct user request chains · zero-to-N and N-to-zero supported
